headline: SSX: your thumb gets the dual-stick back
lede: Jon picked analogue for #873, so the phone pad now carries a physical stick: tilt depth carves with real edge pressure, forward tilt tucks and commits a front flip.

notes.text: SSX touch pad: always-visible analogue stick — x is carve depth through the sim's press ramp, y tilt picks tuck/scrub and the FLIP direction (forward = front flip).

The tilt law lives in sim.js as pure exports, so physics and replay hashes are untouched; ssxcheck grew 9 node gates (229/229) and the browser drive proves FLIP+tilt lands a negative flip ledger while FLIP alone goes positive.
Mutant proof: swapping the two signs in the tilt law turns 3 gates red — the direction is pinned, not vibes. The discrete FRNT touch button retires; keyboard and gamepad keep both flips.
Next on the board: SSX more and longer courses (#889).

look.text: Ride SSX with the new stick — tilt forward off a lip for a front flip
